                        ( p. 33 ) A آدمي आदमी ādmī , s.m. A descendant of Adam; a human being; man; individual, person; adult; a sensible, or honest man; mankind; people; husband; wife; servant, attendant, retainer: — ādmī banānā , v.t. To humanize, civilize; to make a rational creature of; to teach manners: — ādmī-pīćhe , adv. Per man; severally, individually; one by one: — ādmī-zād = ādam-zād , q.v.s.v. ādam : — ādmī hona , or ho-jānā , To become a man, attain to manhood; to become civilized, learn manners, &c. to recover one's reason; come to one's senses.
